Why Alex & Lia

Why choose Alex & Lia?

Because the internet should be simple. Behind this website, there is a person who designs your website, puts it online and answers you. And an autonomous assistant who helps him work faster.

A real person

It is me, Alex, who reads your messages and replies to you.

A price on display

The same for everyone, with no quote and no surprises.

Nothing ties you down

No commitment, and your domain name stays in your name.

Lia, behind the scenes

She automates repetitive tasks to cut lead times and costs.

Alex, a real person to talk to

My name is Alex. I create websites for freelancers, tradespeople, shops and associations. I am based in Signy-l’Abbaye, in the Ardennes, and I work remotely for clients all over France.

When you write to me, I am the one reading. When your website is live, I am the one answering for it. You are not dealing with a switchboard or an anonymous ticket, but with someone who knows your website.

I am a young entrepreneur. My starting idea is simple: small organisations should have a professional website too, at a price they can afford, not just big companies.

You can ask me your questions before you order, with no commitment at all. If my offer does not fit your needs, I will tell you frankly.

My method, in four steps

  1. We talk: you tell me what you do, who for, and what you expect from the website. The choices are made with you.
  2. I design your website: the structure, the pages, the style. Along the way, Lia, my autonomous assistant, automates the repetitive tasks, such as the basic layout, the first drafts of text and the settings.
  3. I check: I read everything again, test the website on several devices and fix whatever needs fixing.
  4. I put it online, and I stay around: the domain name, the hosting, the HTTPS padlock, then the follow-up month after month.

My commitments

These are simple promises, written here so you can remind me of them.

  • A price on display: from €500 for the website, in black and white, the same for everyone.
  • No commitment: the subscription stops when you decide. One exception: if you pay for the website in 6 or 12 instalments, you stay until it is paid off.
  • The domain name in your name: your website’s address belongs to you, not to me.
  • You leave with your website: if you stop, I give you a full copy, and your address goes with you.
  • Nothing goes live unchecked: I check your website before it goes live, and every change by Lia goes through a preview that you approve.
  • A reply within 72 hours: support is included in the subscription, for all your questions about your website.

Lia, my assistant

Lia is my autonomous assistant, set up for the websites I design. She automates repetitive tasks, and that is what brings down lead times and costs. Designing your website remains my job.

Once your website is live, she also handles the small changes you ask for from your client area: opening hours, a price, a photo. These changes use the tokens included in your subscription. She always shows you a preview before changing anything. As soon as a request is too big or unclear, she passes it to me.

What Lia does not do: she does not sell anything, she does not decide for you, and she does not replace me. She cannot delete a page or touch your website’s sensitive settings.

On this website, you will also meet our two mascots, two cute little monsters. They are here to remind you that the internet can stay friendly.

What I do well, and what I do not do

I create one-page websites, showcase websites and small online shops. That is what I do well, quickly and with care. You can see a few of them in our work.

For a custom app, specialist business software or a catalogue of thousands of products, you need an experienced developer. In that case, I will tell you honestly, and I can point you to the right people.

My prices stay low because I took the time to automate my work, and because I deal directly with French hosting providers. The why it costs less page explains everything.

Your questions

Am I talking to a real person?

Yes. Messages from the contact form come to me, and I am the one who replies. In your client area, Lia can prepare a small change, but you can always choose to come to me instead.

Can Lia make mistakes?

Yes, like any tool. That is why she shows a preview before every change, why she has no access to sensitive settings, and why I check every website before publishing it.

What if I want to leave one day?

You are free to leave. The domain name is already in your name, and I give you your website’s files so you can host it elsewhere.

Do I need to live near you?

No. Everything can be done remotely, by email, phone or video call, anywhere in France. If you are in the Ardennes, we can also meet.
